top_signals.title: Vista Energy up 4% after billionaire Peter Thiel buys stake in the Argentine shale oil producer
top_signals.summary: Peter Thiel’s hedge fund disclosed a $76 million stake in Argentine oil producer Vista Energy, sending its shares higher in premarket trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
top_signals.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast to the East Coast (PADD 1) also increased.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Austria’s FMA fines crypto broker Bitpanda $81,000 in first published MiCA penalty
top_signals.summary: Austria's FMA fined Bitpanda €70,000 in its first published MiCA penalty, citing white paper and marketing disclosure failures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
